description: NGS-UI ACMG rule engine thresholds (plan docs/research/NGS_Integrated_Prioritization_Plan_v3.md section 5.2). Values marked provisional must be validated (section 5.2.10).

pvs1._note: 2026-11-25 v1.12: NMD is predicted from the MANE exon structure (ClinGen SVI 2018: escape only in the last exon or the 3'-most 50 nt of the penultimate exon), before the VEP NMD plugin, which flags 52 nt, uses the variant position for frameshifts and treats the first 100 coding bases as escaping.

pp2.note: 2026-11-24 v1.8: benign fraction ≤20% (was 10%); PM1 ClinVar hotspots count ≥1★ P/LP (was ≥2★). ClinVar-label check: PM1 LR+ 102→137, PP2 LR+ 25→16, AUC 0.976→0.976

pm5.note: 2026-11-24 v1.4: other missense at the residue needs ClinVar ≥1★ (was ≥2★); PS1 stays ≥2★

clinvar.note: 2026-11-23: 2★ adopted directly (was 3★); floor kept for adopt_min_stars > floor_min_stars. 2026-11-25 v1.12: above override_max_af (max AF, BA1 level) ClinVar P/LP no longer exempts BA1/BS1 and is not adopted, unless the variant is on the ClinGen BA1 exception list (ba1_exceptions.tsv, Ghosh 2018) or a VCEP call exists. In ClinVar 2026-11 only one P/LP variant with >=2 submitters has ExAC/1000G/ESP AF >= 5 % (PRSS1, a known artefact region). 2026-11-26 v1.13: rank_mode 'own' (user decision): a ClinVar >=2★ call no longer adopts or floors the points or the ranking; the rule's own call is shown and ranked, ClinVar stays a separate reference on the card. A ClinGen VCEP call is still adopted. 'floor' (P/LP >=2★ raises ranking and points to floor_points, one-way) and 'adopt' (rule <=v1.12) are kept for the validation (plan §5.2.10). The P/LP >=2★ exemption from BA1/BS1 below override_max_af and from the in-house common penalty is unchanged.

pm1_collagen.note: Gly of a Gly-X-Y triple-helix run (collagen_gly.json from UniProt) → PM1_Moderate

vcep.note: ClinGen CSpec specs in vcep_specs.json (scripts/acmg_engine/update_vcep_specs.py): per-gene criteria applicability and strength caps, BA1/BS1/PM2 thresholds, PM1 hotspots

ps4.note: 2026-11-24 v1.6: PS4 by proband counting (ClinGen VCEP style) instead of PP5; dominant genes with PM2 met only (recessive cases go to PM3). A: other unrelated patients marked Causative on this platform, 1 Supporting / 2-3 Moderate / >=4 Strong. B: ClinVar submitters reporting the variant in affected individuals (clinical testing, research, provider interpretation, case-control; literature-only and curation excluded; B/LB submissions excluded), capped at Supporting because case details and independence cannot be checked. The stronger of A and B is used (not added: the same patient may be in both). v1.7: when PM3 (ClinVar biallelic) is also met, only the stronger of PS4 and PM3 counts.

pm3.note: 2026-11-24 v1.7: PM3 from ClinVar submissions that describe homozygous or compound-heterozygous / in-trans / biallelic patients (structured ObservedData counts or the submitter's comment text, clinvar_cases.sqlite). Genes with AR inheritance only; not when BA1/BS1 is met. The partner variant's classification and the phase cannot be checked and several submitters may describe the same published patients, so 1 submitter gives Supporting and >=2 give Moderate (ClinGen SVI PM3 would allow up to Very strong with verified cases). In a gene with both AD and AR inheritance PM3 and PS4 can describe the same patients: only the stronger is kept. 2026-11-26 v1.13 (user decision): a submitter that states the trans phase explicitly ("in trans", "on the opposite allele") with a pathogenic / likely pathogenic partner gives Strong; hedged phrases (presumed, phase unknown, whether, parental testing not performed), in cis and partners of uncertain significance do not count. ClinGen SVI would need >=2 points (e.g. two probands in trans with a P variant) for Strong; one submitter may describe a single proband, so this is provisional and listed for validation.

ps3.note: 2026-11-26 v1.13 (user decision): PS3 from ClinVar submissions (any method, not B/LB, current) whose comment text reports a functional study (experimental, in vitro, RNA / minigene, enzyme activity, patient cells) with an abnormal result for this variant (clinvar_cases.sqlite schema 3). In-silico predictions and modelling, other variants (different substitution, same codon), normal / conflicting / insufficient results and studies not performed are skipped. Assay validation (controls, OddsPath; Brnich 2019) cannot be checked, so Supporting only. Not with PVS1 (the assay usually confirms the predicted loss of function) or BA1/BS1. BS3 not evaluated. Validate against ClinGen ERepo / VCEP-applied PS3 and a manual review of 50 snippets; ClinVar-label validation would be circular.

pm2._note: ACMG 2015: absent from controls (or extremely low frequency if recessive, incl. X-linked recessive) = Moderate. Present at a low frequency otherwise = Supporting. With PVS1, PM2 counts as Supporting (ClinGen SVI 2020) so PVS1+PM2 alone stays Likely pathogenic. VCEP specs still cap the strength.
